whoWeAre.title: Who We Are
whoWeAre.p1: 9STAR Technologies is a digital problem-solving organization. We believe that technology should be accessible, practical, and focused on real-world results.
whoWeAre.p2: We are not just developers or consultants; we are partners who take the time to understand your unique challenges and deliver solutions that actually work.

whatWeDo.title: What We Do
whatWeDo.p1: We build websites, develop applications, automate business processes, and solve complex online challenges.
whatWeDo.p2: Whether you need a simple digital presence, help with complex documentation, or a complete operational automation system, we have the capability to guide you from concept to launch.

missionVision.missionDesc: To simplify the digital landscape for our clients by providing straightforward, reliable, and high-quality technology solutions that solve tangible problems.
missionVision.visionDesc: To become the most trusted and approachable technology partner for organizations looking to navigate and thrive in a digital-first world.

values.title: Transparency

values.title: Practicality

values.title: Quality

values.title: Human-Centric
values.desc: Technology is for people. We design and build with the end-user in mind, ensuring our solutions are usable and accessible.

timeline.title: The 9STAR Methodology
timeline.subtitle: A predictable, repeatable path from your initial idea to a launched solution.

01.title: Discover
01.description: We start by learning about your organization, your goals, and identifying your core challenges without technical jargon.

02.title: Understand

04.title: Request
04.description: Once the plan is approved, we formalize the project requirements and gather any necessary assets from your team.

05.description: Our team builds the solution. You receive regular updates and maintain full visibility into our progress.

06.description: We test thoroughly and present the work for your feedback, ensuring it matches the agreed-upon specifications.

07.description: We hand over the finalized project, handle deployment, and provide necessary training for your team.

faqSection.title: Common Questions
faqSection.subtitle: Everything you need to know before we begin.

afterContact.question: What happens after I contact you?
afterContact.answer: We typically schedule a brief, no-pressure introductory call. The goal is simply to discuss your needs, answer your initial questions, and determine if we are the right fit for your project.

informationNeeded.question: What information do you need?
informationNeeded.answer: Initially, just a general idea of your goal or problem. Once a project begins, we will provide a clear checklist of specific assets, access credentials, or documentation required.

responseWhen.question: When will you respond?
responseWhen.answer: We respect your time. Our team aims to respond to all new inquiries and service requests within 1 to 2 business days.

pricing.question: How does pricing work?
pricing.answer: We believe in transparent, upfront pricing. Depending on the nature of the work, we provide a fixed project fee, a structured package, or a clear hourly estimate. No hidden surprises.

revisions.question: How are revisions handled?
revisions.answer: Each project phase includes designated review cycles. We ensure you are completely satisfied with the progress before we lock it in and move to the next phase.

receiveResult.question: How do I receive the final result?
receiveResult.answer: We handle the technical deployment and data migration. Upon completion, we hand off all ownership, source files (if applicable), and documentation via secure channels.

afterCompletion.question: What happens after completion?
afterCompletion.answer: Technology requires upkeep. We offer optional support and maintenance plans to ensure your solution remains secure, updated, and optimized as your business grows.
